intro.what: "There is" va "There are" iboralari o'zbek tilidagi "bor" so'ziga to'g'ri keladi. Ular biror narsa yoki shaxsning ma'lum bir joyda mavjudligini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.
when: Ko'plikdagi (ikki va undan ortiq) narsalarning borligini aytishda.
Biror joyda biror narsa bor-yo'qligini so'rashda.

structures.formula: There is a/an + [singular noun] / There are some + [plural noun]
structures.example_en: There is a sofa in the room. There are some books on the desk.
structures.example_uz: Xonada divan bor. Parta ustida bir nechta kitoblar bor.

structures.formula: There isn't a/an + [singular noun] / There aren't any + [plural noun]
structures.example_en: There isn't a TV. There aren't any chairs.
structures.example_uz: Televizor yo'q. Hech qanday stullar yo'q.

structures.formula: Is there a/an + [singular noun]? / Are there any + [plural noun]?
structures.example_en: Is there a cat? Are there any shops?

structures.label: Qisqa javob
structures.formula: Yes, there is/are. / No, there isn't/aren't.
structures.example_en: Is there a bank? Yes, there is.

rules.title: A/An vs Some
rules.text: Darak gaplarda bitta narsa uchun 'a/an', ko'p narsalar uchun esa 'some' (bir nechta) ishlatiladi.

rules.title: Any ishlatilishi
rules.text: Inkor (-) va so'roq (?) gaplarda ko'plikdagi otlar bilan 'some' emas, 'any' ishlatiladi.

rules.title: How many
rules.text: 'How many' (nechta) so'rog'idan keyin ot doim ko'plikda keladi.

mistakes.why: Ko'plikdagi otlar bilan so'roq gapda 'Is there' emas, 'Are there' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There ______ a large sofa in the living room.
test.explain: Birlikdagi ot (a sofa) bo'lgani uchun 'is' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There ______ two bedrooms in the flat.
test.explain: Ko'plikdagi ot (two bedrooms) bilan 'are' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There ______ any chairs in the kitchen.
test.explain: Inkor gapda ko'plikdagi ot (chairs) bilan 'aren't' ishlatiladi.

test.q: ______ there a television in the bedroom?
test.explain: Birlikdagi ot (a television) bilan so'roq gapda 'Is' gap boshiga chiqadi.

test.q: Are there ______ pictures on the wall?
test.explain: So'roq gaplarda ko'plikdagi otlar bilan 'any' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There is ______ armchair next to the window.
test.explain: 'Armchair' unli bilan boshlangani uchun 'an' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There are ______ books on the desk.
test.explain: Darak gapda ko'plikdagi otlar bilan 'some' ishlatiladi.

test.q: How ______ children are there in the family?
test.explain: Sanaladigan otlarning miqdorini so'rashda 'How many' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There ______ a cat under the table.
test.explain: Bitta mushuk (a cat) haqida gap ketmoqda, shuning uchun 'is' kerak.

test.q: There ______ any eggs in the fridge.
test.explain: Inkor gapda 'any' bilan ko'plikdagi ot (eggs) kelsa 'aren't' ishlatiladi.

test.q: ______ there any shops near the hotel?
test.explain: Ko'plikdagi ot (shops) bilan so'roq gap 'Are' bilan boshlanadi.

test.q: Is there a computer? No, there ______.
test.explain: 'Is there' savoliga inkor javob 'No, there isn't' bo'ladi.

test.q: There is a lamp ______ to the bed.
test.explain: 'Next to' iborasi 'yonida' degan ma'noni beradi.

test.q: How many students ______ there in the classroom?
test.explain: 'How many' bilan so'roq gapda 'are there' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There ______ a dictionary in the drawer.
test.explain: Birlikdagi ot (a dictionary) bilan 'is' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There isn't ______ shower in the bathroom.
test.explain: Inkor gapda birlikdagi ot bilan 'a' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There are some bags ______ the floor.
test.explain: Polning ustida bo'lgani uchun 'on' predlogi ishlatiladi.

test.q: Are there ______ sandwiches in the bag?
test.explain: So'roq gapda ko'plikdagi ot (sandwiches) bilan 'any' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There ______ a big park near my house.
test.explain: Bitta park haqida gapirilmoqda, shuning uchun 'is' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There ______ any magazines in the office.
test.explain: Inkor gapda ko'plikdagi ot (magazines) bilan 'aren't' ishlatiladi.

test.q: ______ a bus station in the town centre.
test.explain: Birlikdagi ot (a bus station) mavjudligini aytish uchun 'There is' ishlatiladi.

test.q: Are there ______ apples?
test.explain: So'roq gapda ko'plikdagi ot bilan 'any' ishlatiladi.

test.q: There ______ any cars in the car park.
test.explain: Ko'plikdagi ot (cars) va 'any' bilan inkor shakli 'aren't' bo'ladi.

test.q: How many bathrooms ______?
test.explain: So'roq gapda 'are there' shakli ishlatiladi.

test.q: There's ______ orange on the table.
test.explain: 'Orange' so'zi unli bilan boshlangani uchun 'an' artikli qo'yiladi.

test.q: ______ there a phone in the kitchen?
test.explain: Birlikdagi ot (a phone) bilan so'roq gap 'Is' bilan boshlanadi.

test.q: There are some ______ in the living room.
test.explain: 'There are some' dan keyin ot ko'plikda kelishi kerak.

test.q: Is there a cooker? No, there ______.
test.explain: 'Is there' bilan berilgan savolga inkor javob 'isn't' bilan tugaydi.

test.q: There's a small table ______ the sofa.
test.explain: Divanning yonida demoqchi bo'lsak 'next to' ishlatamiz.

test.q: There ______ a lot of people in the park today.
test.explain: 'People' so'zi doim ko'plikda bo'lgani uchun 'are' ishlatiladi.
